subject.title: feat(browser): add GPT-5.6 Sol model aliases

question: Should Oracle adopt `gpt-5.6` as a moving browser alias for the current GPT-5.6 default while keeping `gpt-5.6-sol` permanently pinned to the Sol picker entry?
rationale: The implementation is technically credible, but the permanence and future movement of public CLI aliases is a compatibility policy choice that repository history does not settle.

options.title: Adopt moving and pinned aliases
options.body: Accept both names with `gpt-5.6` allowed to move to a future GPT-5.6 default and `gpt-5.6-sol` remaining stable.

options.title: Ship only the pinned alias
options.body: Expose only `gpt-5.6-sol` until there is a clearer long-term default-alias policy.

options.title: Defer both aliases
options.body: Keep using explicit ChatGPT labels until GPT-5.6 naming and availability stabilize.

recommendation.title: Adopt moving and pinned aliases
recommendation.body: Accept both names with `gpt-5.6` allowed to move to a future GPT-5.6 default and `gpt-5.6-sol` remaining stable.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history shows the strongest ownership of Oracle's model alias, browser picker, and release behavior.
